强调事物的实际用途而非装饰性或情感价值
常用搭配in the vicinity of表示“在……附近”
主语通常为表示时间的名词，无被动语态
可指时间或空间的间隔，常用搭配time interval表示“时间间隔”
指用于特定用途的成套或专用设备，复数可加es或保持原形
表示鱼群时为可数名词，常用搭配a shoal of fish
表示鱼类的可数名词，单复数同形
表示鱼类的可数名词，单复数同形
及物动词，宾语多为声音、光线、气味等名词
指尖锐、短促的声音，也可作动词表示“发出吱吱声”

meanings.meaning: 驾驶，引导， steer clear of表示“避开，绕开”
meanings.usage: 既可以指操控交通工具，也可表示抽象的“引导、避开”
可指具体的阻挡物，也可指抽象的困难、阻碍
不可数名词，指利用无线电波探测目标的技术或设备

phrases.usage: 表示“充当，用作，起……作用”，主语可以是人或物，后接表示身份、功能的名词

examples.en: Not all sounds made by animals serve as language.
examples.zh: 动物发出的声音并不都起语言的作用。

examples.en: The old sofa can serve as a bed for one night.
examples.zh: 这个旧沙发可以当床睡一晚。

phrases.usage: 表示“求助于，查阅，转向”，后可接人、书籍、某个领域等名词

examples.en: To get a full appreciation of what this means we must turn first to some recent human inventions.
examples.zh: 要充分理解这一点的含义，我们必须首先参考人类最近的一些发明。

examples.en: When you meet new words, you can turn to a dictionary.
examples.zh: 遇到生词时你可以查词典。

phrases.usage: 表示“在……附近，邻近”，为正式用语，后接地点名词

examples.en: If he shouts in the vicinity of a wall or a mountainside, an echo will come back.
examples.zh: 如果人在墙壁或山坡附近大喊，就会传来回声。

examples.en: There are three cafes in the vicinity of the campus.
examples.zh: 校园附近有三家咖啡馆。

phrases.usage: 表示“从……反射回来”，主语多为声音、光线等，后接反射的载体

examples.en: A sound made by tapping on the hull of a ship will be reflected from the sea bottom.
examples.zh: 敲击船体发出的声音会从海底反射回来。

examples.en: Sunlight reflects from the surface of the lake. 阳光从湖面反射回来。
examples.zh: 阳光从湖面反射回来。

phrases.usage: 表示“普遍使用，通用”，描述某类设备、方法等被广泛应用的状态

examples.en: So was born the echo-sounding apparatus, now in general use in ships.
examples.zh: 回声探测仪就这样诞生了，如今在船舶上被普遍使用。

examples.en: Mobile payment is already in general use across the country.
examples.zh: 移动支付已经在全国范围内普遍使用。

phrases.usage: 表示“根据……而变化”，主语为被影响的对象，后接影响因素

examples.en: Every solid object will reflect a sound, varying according to the size and nature of the object.
examples.zh: 所有固体都会反射声音，反射情况根据物体的大小和性质而不同。

examples.en: The price of the product varies according to the season.
examples.zh: 这款产品的价格随季节变化。

phrases.usage: 表示“避开，绕开”，既可指避开具体的障碍物，也可指避开抽象的人或麻烦

examples.en: They can locate and steer clear of obstacles.
examples.zh: 它们能够定位并避开障碍物。

examples.en: You should steer clear of that person; he is not reliable.
examples.zh: 你应该离那个人远点，他不可靠。

phrases.usage: 表示“以……为食”，主语为动物或生物，后接食物来源

examples.en: They can locate flying insects on which they feed.
examples.zh: 它们还能找到自己捕食的飞虫。

examples.en: Owls feed on small mammals such as mice.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰以老鼠之类的小型哺乳动物为食。

phrases.usage: 表示“被与……相比”，用于同类事物的类比，主动形式为compare A with B

examples.en: This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar, the principle of which is similar.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠的这种回声定位常被拿来和雷达作比较，二者原理相似。

examples.en: The work of a teacher is often compared with that of a gardener.
examples.zh: 教师的工作常被比作园丁的工作。

grammar.title: 完全倒装句
grammar.structure: So/状语 + 谓语 + 主语 + 其他成分
grammar.definition: 将谓语动词完全置于主语之前的倒装结构，常用于以so、only、表示地点/方向的副词开头的句子，且主语为名词时使用，作用是强调或保持句子平衡 当前文描述的情况同样适用于后者，或者为了避免句子头重脚轻时使用完全倒装

examples.en: So was born the echo-sounding apparatus, now in general use in ships.
examples.zh: 回声探测仪就这样诞生了，如今在船舶上被普遍使用。

examples.en: Here comes the bus that we have been waiting for.
examples.zh: 我们等的公交车来了。

grammar.title: 介词+which引导的定语从句
grammar.structure: 先行词 + 介词 + which + 从句剩余部分
grammar.definition: 定语从句的一种引导形式，当关系代词which在从句中作介词的宾语时，可将介词提前到which之前，使句子结构更紧凑，多用于正式文体 介词的选择通常与先行词的搭配或从句中的动词/形容词搭配相关

examples.en: This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar, the principle of which is similar.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠的这种回声定位常被拿来和雷达作比较，二者原理相似。

examples.en: The book from which I got a lot of useful information was written by a famous scientist.
examples.zh: 那本给了我很多有用信息的书是一位著名科学家写的。

grammar.title: it作形式主语的主语从句
grammar.structure: It + be + 形容词/名词 + (for sb) + 真正主语（不定式/that从句等）
grammar.definition: 当主语部分是较长的不定式、动名词或从句时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，用it作形式主语放在句首，真正的主语放在句子后半部分 常用于表示“……是可能的/重要的/明显的”等含义的句子中

examples.en: It has been found that certain bats emit squeaks and by receiving the echoes, they can locate and steer clear of obstacles.
examples.zh: 人们已经发现，某些蝙蝠会发出吱吱声，通过接收回声，它们能够定位并避开障碍物。

examples.en: It is possible for us to finish the project ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们有可能提前完成这个项目。

patterns.pattern: Not all + 名词 + 谓语 + 其他, and we have only to turn to + 例子 to see a case in which + 具体情况

original.en: Not all sounds made by animals serve as language, and we have only to turn to that extraordinary discovery of echo-location in bats to see a case in which the voice plays a strictly utilitarian role.
original.zh: 动物发出的声音并不都起语言的作用，我们只要以蝙蝠回声定位这一非凡发现为例，就能看到声音发挥完全实用功能的情况。

imitations.en: Not all after-school classes are beneficial to children, and we have only to turn to those repetitive training courses to see a case in which extra study actually reduces kids' interest in learning.
imitations.zh: 并非所有课外班都对孩子有益，我们只要看看那些重复性的训练课程，就能发现额外学习实际上会降低孩子学习兴趣的情况。

imitations.en: Not all technological advances bring positive effects, and we have only to turn to the problem of personal information leakage to see a case in which new technology creates unexpected risks.
imitations.zh: 并非所有技术进步都带来积极影响，我们只要看看个人信息泄露问题，就能发现新技术造成意外风险的情况。

patterns.pattern: With + 名词, it is now possible not only to do sth but to do sth by + 方式

original.en: With experience, and with improved apparatus, it is now possible not only to locate a shoal but to tell if it is herring, cod, or other well-known fish, by the pattern of its echo.
original.zh: 凭借经验和改进的仪器，现在人们不仅能够定位鱼群，还能根据回声的模式判断它是鲱鱼、鳕鱼还是其他知名鱼类。

imitations.en: With big data technology, and with optimized recommendation algorithms, it is now possible not only to predict users' preferences but to provide them with highly personalized services by their browsing history.
imitations.zh: 凭借大数据技术和优化的推荐算法，现在不仅能够预测用户的偏好，还能根据他们的浏览历史为其提供高度个性化的服务。

imitations.zh: 凭借更好的医疗设备和更专业的医务人员，现在不仅能够治愈这种罕见病，还能通过定期随访降低其复发的可能性。

questions.q: In what way does echo-location in bats play an utilitarian role?
questions.zh: 蝙蝠的回声定位以何种方式发挥实用作用？
questions.a: Certain bats emit squeaks and, by receiving the echoes, they can locate and steer clear of obstacles, or locate the flying insects on which they feed. Here the voice serves no language purpose at all: it works purely as a practical tool, just as radar does.
questions.aZh: 某些蝙蝠发出尖叫声，并靠接收回声来确定并躲开障碍物，或找到它们赖以生存的飞虫。此时声音毫无语言交际的用途，而是纯粹当作实用工具，就像雷达一样。
questions.hint: 答案出处：课文首段提出声音可发挥 strictly utilitarian role，倒数第二段 It has been found that certain bats emit squeaks ... 给出具体解释。

questions.q: How can the depth of the sea at a certain point be calculated by means of sound?
questions.zh: 人类怎样借助声音算出某处海洋的深度？
questions.a: A sound made by tapping on the hull of a ship is reflected from the sea bottom, and by measuring the time interval between the taps and the receipt of the echoes, the depth of the sea at that point can be calculated.
questions.aZh: 敲击船体发出的声音会从海底反射回来；测出敲击与收到回声之间的时间间隔，便可算出该处海洋的深度。
questions.hint: 答案出处：A sound made by tapping on the hull of a ship ... the depth of the sea at that point can be calculated.

questions.q: How is it possible to tell whether a shoal of fish is herring, cod or other well-known fish?
questions.zh: 人们凭什么分辨鱼群是鲱鱼、鳕鱼还是其他常见鱼类？
questions.a: Every solid object reflects a sound varying according to its size and nature, and a shoal of fish does this too. With experience and improved apparatus, one can tell by the pattern of its echo whether the shoal is herring, cod or other well-known fish.
questions.aZh: 任何固体都会反射声音，反射的声音因物体的大小和性质而异，鱼群也如此。有了经验和改进的仪器，人们便可凭鱼群回声的特点分辨出它是鲱鱼、鳕鱼还是其他常见鱼类。
questions.hint: 答案出处：With experience, and with improved apparatus, it is now possible not only to locate a shoal but to tell ... by the pattern of its echo.

questions.q: What basic point does the first sentence of the text make?
questions.zh: 课文第一句提出了什么基本论点？
questions.a: Not all sounds made by animals serve as language: some sounds, such as the squeaks of bats, play a strictly utilitarian role instead of carrying a message.
questions.aZh: 动物发出的声音并非都用作语言交际：有些声音，例如蝙蝠的尖叫声，并不传递信息，而起的是严格的实用作用。
questions.hint: 答案出处：课文首句 Not all sounds made by animals serve as language，是全文主题句，注意 not all 表部分否定。

questions.q: The writer describes human inventions before turning to bats. Why is this order effective?
questions.zh: 作者先讲人类的发明，最后才讲蝙蝠，这样安排有什么好处？
questions.a: It moves from the familiar to the unfamiliar. Readers already know echoes and echo-sounding, and the examples of measuring the sea depth and locating fish prepare them, by analogy, to understand how bats use reflected sound; the final comparison with radar then comes naturally.
questions.aZh: 这样循着由熟悉到陌生的顺序：读者本就了解回声和回声探测，测海深、找鱼群这两个例子为理解蝙蝠如何利用反射声作了类比铺垫，最后与雷达相比也就顺理成章。
questions.hint: 从课文结构看：首句立论—人类发明（测深、测鱼）—蝙蝠回声定位—雷达，属由已知到未知、由浅入深。

translation:
动物发出的声音不都是用作语言交际。
我们只要看一看蝙蝠回声定位这一极不寻常的发现，就可以探究一下声音在什么情况下有绝对的实用价值。
要透彻理解这句话的意义，我们应先回顾一下人类最近的几项发明。
大家都知道，在墙壁或山腰附近发出的喊声，就会听到回声。
固体障碍物越远。
回声返回所用时间就越长。
敲打船体所发了的声音会从海底传回来，测出回声间隔的时间，便可算出该处海洋的深度。
这样就产生了目前各种船舶上普遍应用的回声探测仪。
任何固体者反射声音，反射的声音因物体的大小和性质的不同而不同。
鱼群也反射声音。
从测定海深到测定鱼群，这一进展比较容易。
根据经验和改进了的仪器，不仅能够确定鱼群的位置，而且可以根据鱼群回声的特点分辨出是鲱鱼、鳕鱼，这是人们所熟悉的其他鱼。
人们发现，某些蝙蝠能发出尖叫声，并能通过回声来确定并躲开障碍物，或找到它们赖以为生的昆虫。
蝙蝠这种回声定位常常可与雷达相比较，其原理是相似的。

Theguestswereseatedstrictlyinorderofprecedence.客人严格按照地位高低就座。
I'llbesendingthemadonationinappreciationoftheirhelp.我将送给他们一笔捐款以感谢他们的帮助。
Theroadwasclearedfromobstruction.那条路已被清除了障碍。
Theboat'shullhasbeenstavedinbythetremendousseas.小船壳让巨浪打穿了。
Therewasalongintervalbeforeheanwseredthetelephone.隔了好久他才回了电话。
Theyhadaveryrefinedapparatus.他们有一套非常精良的设备。
CodarefoundintheNorthAtlanticandtheNorthSea.北大西洋和北海有鳕鱼。
Wewonthegame,butitwasanarrowsqueak.我们打赢了这场球赛，不过是侥幸取胜。
来自辞典例句Shealwayssqueaksoutherideaswhensheisexcited.她一激动总是尖声说出自己的想法。

title: Bats
subtitle: 蝙蝠

lead.question: 蝙蝠的回声定位与人类的雷达有何相似之处，它又如何体现声音的实用价值？
lead.warmup: 学这一课之前，先想一想：你在山谷或空旷的大厅里喊一声，会听到什么？声音遇到墙壁或山腰会被反射回来，这就是回声。人类正是利用回声制成了回声测深仪，并把它用于探测鱼群和雷达；而蝙蝠早就掌握了同类本领。课文以回声为线索，先谈人的发明，再讲蝙蝠的回声定位，思路清晰，逻辑严密。
goals: 掌握 utilitarian, echo-location, obstruction, interval, apparatus, shoal, herring, cod, squeak, steer clear of, radar 等词汇与搭配。
学会用 have only to ... to ... 表示“只需……就……”以及用 not all 表示部分否定。
理解 the further ... the longer ... 比较结构，以及 So was born ... 这类倒装句。
能用被动语态和 in which / of which / on which 引导的定语从句说明回声定位的原理。
lead.summary: 动物发出的声音并非都用于交际。课文先讲人类的发明：敲击船体，声音自海底反射，测出间歇时间便可算出海深，回声测深仪由此问世；固体都能反射声音，鱼群亦然。由测海深到测鱼群只是一小步，凭回声特点还能分辨鲱鱼、鳕鱼。最后转到蝙蝠：某些蝙蝠发出尖叫声，靠接收回声确定并躲开障碍物，找到赖以生存的昆虫，这与雷达原理相似。
lead.tips: 注意 Not all sounds made by animals serve as language 是部分否定，意为“动物发出的声音并非都用作语言交际”，不可译成“动物发出的声音都不是语言”；要表达全部否定须用 No sounds made by animals serve as language。

exercises.q: 汉译英：动物发出的声音并非都用作语言交际。
exercises.a: Not all sounds made by animals serve as language.

exercises.q: 填空：The further off this solid obstruction, the longer time will ______ for the return of the echo.
填空：We have only ______ turn to that extraordinary discovery of echo-location in bats.
exercises.note: have only to 意为“只需”。

exercises.q: 句型转换：把 It has been found that certain bats emit squeaks ... 改为以 People 作主语的主动句。
exercises.a: People have found that certain bats emit squeaks ...
exercises.note: 被动句可还原为 People have found。

exercises.q: 汉译英：敲击船体发出的声音会从海底反射回来，据此可以算出该处海洋的深度。
exercises.a: A sound made by tapping on the hull of a ship is reflected from the sea bottom, and by measuring the time interval the depth of the sea at that point can be calculated.

exercises.q: 用“介词 + which”定语从句合并：①Bats locate flying insects. They feed on the insects. ②This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar. The principle of radar is similar.
exercises.a: ①Bats locate flying insects on which they feed. ②This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar, the principle of which is similar.
exercises.note: 介词+which 还原介词于从句。

exercises.q: 改错：Bats can locate and steer clear from obstacles, or locate flying insects.
exercises.a: Bats can locate and steer clear of obstacles, or locate flying insects.
exercises.note: steer clear of 为固定搭配。

quiz.q: 下面哪句正确表达“动物发出的声音并非都用作语言交际”？
options: All sounds made by animals do not serve as language.
No sounds made by animals serve as language.
Not all sounds made by animals serve as language.
Not any sounds made by animals serve as language.

quiz.q: The further off this solid obstruction, the longer time will ______ for the return of the echo. 应填哪一项？
options: collapse
elapse
relapse
elaborate

quiz.q: 下列哪句用被动语态正确表达“该处海洋的深度便可算出”？
options: The depth of the sea at that point can calculate.
The depth of the sea at that point can be calculating.
The depth of the sea at that point can be calculated.
The depth of the sea at that point can calculated.
quiz.note: can 后接 be + 过去分词。

quiz.q: This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar, ______ 应选哪一项补全？
options: the principle of which is similar
which principle is similar
its principle is similar
of which the principle similar
quiz.note: of which 引导非限定定语从句。

quiz.q: 根据课文，蝙蝠靠什么来确定并躲开障碍物？
options: By using its sharp eyes in the dark.
By smelling the obstacles ahead of it.
By giving out squeaks and receiving the echoes.
By the radar it carries in its body.

quiz.q: 下列哪句正确使用 not only ... but ... 的并列结构？
options: With experience, it is now possible not only to locate a shoal but to tell if it is herring or cod.
With experience, it is now possible not only to locate a shoal but telling if it is herring or cod.
With experience, it is now possible not only locating a shoal but to tell if it is herring or cod.
With experience, it is now possible not only to locate a shoal but also tell if it is herring or cod.
quiz.note: not only...but 后并列 to do。
